messages:
julia: quick q — for /v2/generate structured outputs: when schema marks a field as nullable vs optional, do we return the key with null or omit? mobile parser broke on a missing `author`.

matt: I thought we standardized on returning null when the schema explicitly allows null. omission used to indicate 'unknown' vs null meaning 'explicitly null'.

ravi: which mobile parser? iOS swift? they rely on decodeFailingUnlessKeyPresent?

julia: yes iOS Codable currently expects key present or it errors. web client handles missing fine. so this is a regression after the runtime change last week.

matt: ack. timeline — we changed the structured-output encoder to be sparse to save tokens for streaming. that caused omission. didn't think about clients.

olga: for clarity: what Content-Type are we returning? streaming ndjson vs application/json+schema?

julia: this was a non-streaming response: Content-Type: application/json; schema=v1

sara: i'd prefer canonical contract: if schema declares field nullable (e.g. "author": ["string","null"]) then server MUST include the key and set null. if field is optional (not required) server can omit. keeps clients deterministic.

matt: agree with sara. that gives clear rule. backwards-compat: many endpoints already omitted optional keys; keep that. only change behavior for explicit nullable union types.

ravi: can we add a compatibility flag? default safe change is fine but need tests.

julia: i'll open a tiny PR to the encoder to switch to 'emit-null-for-nullable-types' and add a toggle env var.

ci-bot: job started: contract/response-shape (runs: unit + integration) — https://ci.redwood/1234

matt: ping @julia send the PR link here and tag me. i'll do a quick review.

julia: PR: https://git.redwood/rdw/encoder/pulls/5678 — implements rule + adds schema tests. includes sample fixture:

```json
{"id":"msg1","author":null,"content":"hello"}
```

olga: small note: streaming NDJSON should keep current sparse behavior for perf. add a warning to docs.

sara: agree. add API compatibility notes and a migration guide for mobile.

matt: rollout plan: merge -> canary 100 hosts -> monitor errors for 24h -> full rollout. add a fallback toggle at runtime in case of issues.

julia: will add canary config + feature flag. also adding a unit test for iOS client expectation.

ravi: thanks. once PR merged i'll update release notes and notify integrations.

julia: thanks all :thumbsup:
